title: Animal Sounds Hide and Seek | Find All 10 Friends! | Thumpy Meadow
description_intro: S1 pilot (yukleme yok): Dino finds ten hiding animal friends on the farm, at the pond and in the meadow.
learning_points: Copy fun movements: hop, dance, spin, flap, stomp, wiggle

finds.action_line: The cow can dance! Can you dance too?

finds.notice: Look, a pond! The cloud is wiggling!
finds.action_line: The duck can flap! Can you flap too?

finds.notice: Look! The big tree is shaking!
finds.action_line: The sheep can hop! Can you hop too?

finds.notice: Back on the farm! The bush is wiggling!
finds.action_line: The dog can stomp! Can you stomp too?

finds.notice: Look! A bush by the pond!
finds.action_line: The frog can hop! Can you hop too?
The cat can wiggle! Can you wiggle too?

finds.notice: Look! The bush by the barn!
finds.action_line: The horse can stomp! Can you stomp too?
The chick can spin! Can you spin too?

finds.notice: Look! The tree by the pond is shaking!
finds.action_line: The owl can flap! Can you flap too?

finds.notice: Look up! The cloud is wiggling!
finds.action_line: The rooster can dance! Can you dance too?

lines: Let us hop and clap and spin,
Stomp your feet and jump up high,
March and stretch and wiggle round,
Flap your arms up so high,
Hop and clap and spin in a ring,

finale: Thank you, friends! I love you!
teaser_line: Next time, a new friend comes to play!
